description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a lean healthtech team as its first AI and backend engineering hire. You will build the AI coaching engine and backend services that support personalized fitness coaching, owning systems from prototype through production.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own AI coaching capabilities, including agents, tool calling, memory, personalization, and guardrails.

 - Develop backend services, data models, APIs, and integrations for the coaching business.

 - Bring prototypes to production with monitoring, evaluations, and controls for cost and latency.

 - Use AI coding tools to plan and implement software efficiently.

 - Help shape engineering practices and tooling as the team grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on software engineering experience, from early-career candidates with shipped projects to experienced engineers; research-only experience is not a fit.

 - Strong Python skills and experience building backend services.

 - Experience shipping real products using LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini.

 - Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code to implement and ship software.

 - Ownership, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias toward shipping; startup experience, founding experience, or substantial side projects are relevant.

 - Firebase or GCP experience and an interest in fitness or health are helpful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$180,000 base salary plus meaningful equity. Visa sponsorship policy was not provided.


LOCATION

Hybrid in New York City. Candidates must be based in New York City or willing to relocate.
